segments.description: Medium establishing shot of Ed Sheeran walking into a luxurious, upscale restaurant [[00:01](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=keOaQm6RpBg&t=1)].
Medium close-up shot of the lavish dining room featuring chandeliers, classical pianist, and formal table settings [[00:07](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=keOaQm6RpBg&t=7)].
Medium close-up shot of the hostess greeting Ed Sheeran at the podium [[00:20](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=keOaQm6RpBg&t=20)].
Medium shot of a waiter explaining the fancy farm-to-table menu to Ed at his table [[00:26](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=keOaQm6RpBg&t=26)].
Close-up action shot of the waiter lifting the silver cloche to reveal gourmet, high-end dishes [[00:35](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=keOaQm6RpBg&t=35)].
Medium close-up action shot of Ed pulling a bottle of Heinz Ketchup from his backpack and setting it on the table [[00:48](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=keOaQm6RpBg&t=48)].
Wide closing shot of Ed Sheeran enjoying his meal with ketchup at the posh restaurant, followed by the product logo reveal [[01:03](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=keOaQm6RpBg&t=63)].
